title: The Price of the Exit
episode_goal: Tessa must secure a safe evacuation route while exposing official complicity at severe legal cost.
synopsis: Tessa responds to the tower's load shift by breaking a city-sealed fire panel and opening a controlled evacuation route, knowingly exposing herself to prosecution. Deputy Commissioner Voss arrives to stop her, but Tessa displays the authorization token proving Voss countersigned Hale's altered load-test record. character_states.name: Tessa Ward
character_states.motivation: Expose Hale's fraud while getting every resident out safely.

character_states.name: Malik Reyes
character_states.motivation: Protect residents without losing the access needed to finish the evacuation.

character_states.name: Gideon Hale
character_states.motivation: Contain the evidence, preserve occupancy, and make Tessa appear responsible for the crisis.

character_states.name: Deputy Commissioner Celia Voss
character_states.motivation: Protect the oversight department from exposure and personal prosecution.

final_scene_outcome: Tessa is detained and Malik continues the evacuation, but Hale starts a concrete pour that could bury evidence and collapse the slab.
final_turning_point: Tessa realizes Hale's cover-up will add lethal weight before the remaining residents can escape.
next_episode_question: Can Tessa stop Hale's concrete pour before it collapses the transfer slab with Malik and the remaining residents still inside?
